# 0129. The wiki is docs/wiki/&lt;module&gt;.md per top-level code folder plus README.md, written by…

## Context and Problem Statement

Task #188: feat(wiki): a DeepWiki-style wiki generated from specs, ADRs, glossary and code.

## Considered Options

The options are not listed apart; the decision below says what was chosen and why.

## Decision Outcome

The wiki is docs/wiki/&lt;module&gt;.md per top-level code folder plus README.md, written by Sonnet (claude -p) from the files' opening comments, the module's ADRs and the glossary terms they use; a page is rewritten only when that input's hash changes

`npm run wiki [-- --force]`. A page: one paragraph, a Mermaid flowchart, Parts, Decisions, Terms; the index has the modules with their first line and a diagram. Not edited by hand: a page without Imprimatur's header is left alone. Skipped folders: docs, test, assets, dist, node_modules and the like. A model failure keeps the old page. First run here: hooks, mcp, scripts, skills, vscode (cloud is untracked).

## Consequences

Not listed apart; see the decision outcome.
